title: Hatch Routine Start-Time Drift
dataSources: Nanit sleep sessions (`nanit:sleep`), Hatch routines (`hatch:routine`), school calendar events (`schoolcalendar:event`), allowance transactions (`allowance:txn`), and kid screen usage (`screentime:usage`).
app: Family-routine telemetry from Nanit sleep exports, Hatch routine data, school calendars, allowance and chore apps, and Apple Screen Time sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hatch:routine
| search start_offset_min=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(start_offset_min) as avg_start_offset_min max(start_offset_min) as max_start_offset_min by _time routine_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks Hatch routine start time drift over time and breaks it out by routine.
value: Routine drift often predicts bedtime friction before the whole week feels chaotic.
implementation: Send Hatch routine start time drift events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of Hatch routine start time drift by routine.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how Hatch routine start time drift changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
